content:
Tara (Design): quick microcopy + accessibility pass on the guardrail confirm CTA. proposing: primary button text 'Confirm and override' and secondary 'Cancel'. dropping a tiny mock.
Ben (PM): prefer shorter: 'Confirm override' as primary. 'Cancel' okay. Is there legal/audit text we should surface?
Owen (Infra): yes add a short line under the CTA: 'This action will be logged for audit.' server will emit an override event.
Lily (Frontend): accessibility: make sure the confirm button gets focus when the modal opens, and the modal content is announced (role=dialog + aria-modal). also include aria-describedby pointing to the audit text.
Ava (A11y): wording tone: 'override' can sound aggressive. consider 'Apply change (will be audited)'. but keep it clear it's an override of guardrails. Also add keyboard shortcut hint: 'Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel' visible in modal footer.
Tara (Design): candidates: ['Confirm override', 'Apply change (override)', 'Confirm and override']. which is clearest?
Ben (PM): vote: 'Confirm override' — concise and explicit. include small audit line.
Lily (Frontend): implement notes: focus trap, focus primary button, add aria-live region for success/failure. optimistic update with rollback toast 'Override failed. Try again'. toast must be aria-live=assertive.
Owen (Infra): server: when override occurs return a correlation id to show in UI in case of support ticket. include it in success toast: 'Override applied — ref 0xabc123' (short id).
Ava (A11y): confirm modal must not rely on color alone for warning. include icon + text and ensure contrast.
Tara (Design): will update figma with 'Confirm override' primary, 'Cancel' secondary, audit caption and shortcut hint.
deploy-bot: scheduling: guardrail-cta-copy -> staging at 2026-06-02 16:00 UTC :rocket:
Ben (PM): timeline: Lily protos today, A11y review tomorrow, infra to confirm correlation id format. thanks!
